zh: 如果可以重新开始，你想改变什么？
en: If you could start again, what would you change?

zh: 重新开始时，你最想保留什么？
en: What would you most want to keep if you started again?

zh: 如果只重做一小步，你会选哪一步？
en: If you could redo one small step, which would it be?

zh: 什么会让这一次和上一次不同？
en: What could make this time different from the last?

zh: 如果今天是一张新纸，你会先写下什么？
en: If today were a fresh page, what would you write first?

zh: 眼前这件事里，你能决定的一小部分是什么？
en: What is one small part of this situation you can decide for yourself?

zh: 哪一部分，你愿意暂时交给时间？
en: Which part would you be willing to leave to time for now?

zh: 如果结果暂时不变，你想怎样度过接下来的十分钟？
en: If the outcome stays the same for now, how would you like to spend the next ten minutes?

zh: 有什么事，你可以允许它按自己的节奏发生？
en: What could you allow to unfold at its own pace?

zh: 今天，你想把注意力放在哪里？
en: Where would you like to put your attention today?

zh: 眼前的事里，哪一件对你最重要？
en: Which of the things in front of you matters most to you?

zh: 如果今天少做一件事，你会放下哪件？
en: If you did one less thing today, what would you leave out?

zh: 有什么值得你慢一点对待？
en: What deserves a little more time from you?

zh: 你想把省下来的力气留给什么？
en: What would you like to save your energy for?

zh: 如果只留下三样重要的东西，你会留下什么？
en: If you could keep just three things that matter, what would they be?

zh: 对现在的你来说，怎样才算休息？
en: What would count as rest for you right now?

zh: 如果给自己五分钟，你想用来做什么？
en: If you gave yourself five minutes, what would you use them for?

zh: 今天有什么可以晚一点再做？
en: What could wait until a little later today?

zh: 什么时候，你最容易感到从容？
en: When do you find it easiest to feel unhurried?

zh: 如果不用赶路，你会注意到什么？
en: If you were not in a hurry, what might you notice?

zh: 如果朋友遇到同样的事，你想对他说什么？
en: If a friend were facing the same thing, what would you want to say to them?

zh: 今天的自己，有哪一点值得你认可？
en: What is one thing you can give yourself credit for today?

zh: 有没有一件事，你愿意允许自己暂时不会？
en: Is there something you could allow yourself not to know how to do yet?

zh: 如果不必证明什么，你会怎样选择？
en: What would you choose if you had nothing to prove?

zh: 你想对刚才那个烦躁的自己说一句什么？
en: What would you like to say to the frustrated version of yourself from a moment ago?

zh: 如果从明天回头看，今天的什么可能没那么重要？
en: Looking back from tomorrow, what about today might matter less?

zh: 换一个角度，眼前的事还可能意味着什么？
en: From another angle, what else might this situation mean?

zh: 这件事里，有什么是你还不知道的？
en: What is something you do not yet know about this situation?

zh: 如果把“必须”换成“可以”，你会怎么描述眼前的事？
en: If you replaced “must” with “could,” how would you describe what is in front of you?

zh: 你现在需要一个答案，还是一点空间？
en: Do you need an answer right now, or a little space?

zh: 接下来，有哪一步小到你愿意试试？
en: What next step is small enough that you would be willing to try it?

zh: 如果只做五分钟，你想从哪里开始？
en: If you worked on it for just five minutes, where would you start?

zh: 今天怎样的进展，对你来说就够了？
en: What amount of progress would be enough for you today?

zh: 有什么小改变，能让接下来轻松一点？
en: What small change could make what comes next a little easier?

zh: 回到这个页面后，你想先做哪一件事？
en: When you return to this page, what is the first thing you want to do?

zh: 有什么曾经很难的事，现在已经变容易了？
en: What used to be difficult for you that has become easier?

zh: 如果给这件事多一点时间，你希望什么会改变？
en: If you gave this more time, what would you hope might change?

zh: 今天的你，和过去相比有什么不同？
en: What is different about you today compared with the past?

zh: 此刻的什么，你希望以后还记得？
en: What about this moment would you like to remember later?

zh: 有什么变化，你愿意慢慢等它发生？
en: What change would you be willing to wait for patiently?

zh: 什么样的帮助，会让这件事容易一点？
en: What kind of help would make this a little easier?

zh: 有什么请求，你可以晚一点再回应？
en: Is there a request you could respond to a little later?

zh: 怎样的安排，会更尊重你的精力？
en: What arrangement would better respect the energy you have?

zh: 有哪句话，是你希望别人现在对你说的？
en: What would you like someone to say to you right now?

zh: 如果可以把一件事交出去，你会选什么？
en: If you could hand one thing over to someone else, what would you choose?

zh: 今天有什么小事，让你愿意再看一眼？
en: What small thing today made you want to take another look?

zh: 如果暂时没有任务，你最想探索什么？
en: If you had no tasks for a moment, what would you most like to explore?

zh: 有什么平常的东西，是你不想失去的？
en: What ordinary thing would you not want to lose?

zh: 如果给今天取个名字，你会叫它什么？
en: If you gave today a name, what would you call it?

zh: 页面恢复之后，你希望带回去一个怎样的念头？
en: When the page returns, what thought would you like to take back with you?
